track_record.method: Bought at the next session's close after each scan and held for the stated number of sessions. Price returns before costs. Neighbouring scans overlap, so treat the number of independent periods, not scan dates, as the sample size.

portfolio.rules: Top 20 stocks rated Buy or Strong Buy with no red flags, at most 4 per sector, equal weight, reviewed every 21 sessions, bought at the close after the rating was published, 0.2% cost on each trade.

fundamental_evidence.note: Fundamentals as recorded on each scan date, tested against the following 21 sessions. Readings from a handful of dates are noise; verdicts appear after a year of snapshots.

factor_research.method: Rank correlation between each factor and the next 21- or 63-session return in excess of NIFTY, entering at the next close. t-statistics allow for overlapping windows. Supported means |t| of 3 or more, with the same sign in both halves and at both horizons.
caveats: Only stocks tracked today are included, which flatters past results (survivorship bias).
Fundamental factors are not tested: no point-in-time statement history exists yet.
This is evidence about ranking, not a forecast of returns.
